against the authored key in corpus/smoke_fact_key.json, and WRITTEN DOWN

cannot be fitted to its own calibration set.

Two axes are labelled separately because they fail separately: a report
can name the right project and the wrong attribute, and on this corpus it
usually names no project at all. referent: MATCH | MISMATCH | UNRESOLVED
| AMBIGUOUS. attribute: MATCH | MISMATCH | UNRESOLVED. 'MATCH' means the
binding the report asserts agrees with the key for that value.
